items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: Some days Mrs. Clark would take myself and Buddy

ctx.x: Yeah, I’m talking kind of fast. Yeah, little Buddy Clark and Mrs. Clark. Some days Mrs. Clark would take myself and Buddy and the other days, and my mother, I have an award

in her name, she was the first female manager in New York State of the Unemployment Agency and Employment Agency both, in 1947, as a woman and as an Italian woman. She was a bright woman. So she was my model on how to deal with that stuff.
